name: ATM Customer 8
definition: Customer involved in a withdrawal transaction.

Profile.name: Profile
Profile.definition: Profile of the customer selected to perform the transaction.

SelectedLanguage.name: Selected Language
SelectedLanguage.definition: Language selected by the customer at the ATM for the customer session. Reference ISO 639-1 (alpha-2) et ISO 639-2 (alpha-3).

Authentication.name: Authentication
Authentication.definition: Method and data intended to be used for this transaction to authenticate the customer and its card.

AuthenticationResult.name: Authentication Result
AuthenticationResult.definition: Result of the customer authentication for this transaction.
